plain: To strongly desire and work toward a high goal.

webster.text: To desire with eagerness; to pant after an object, great, noble or spiritual; followed by to or after; as to aspire to a crown, or after immortality.

example.quote: If my country should ever think my services worth any thing, it shall be in the humble capacity of a representative : higher than this I will not aspire.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
